description: Java class 'RitaApi' providing an API client for interacting with a third-party service, including request/response field definitions, configuration, and communication logic.

classes.name: RitaApi
classes.description: A Java class for constructing, sending, and receiving API requests to a third-party service, managing request/response data, and handling communication over HTTP.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a request parameter value after validation and type conversion.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified response parameter.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current request/response data.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the internal map of request/response data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the request over HTTP and processes the response, returning a new RitaApi instance with response data.
